description: This file defines a utility enum 'GatewayConnectChallengeSupport' providing static functions to handle nonce extraction from payloads and to wait for a nonce asynchronously with a timeout. It interacts with external protocols and uses async-await patterns.

methods.name: nonce(from:)
methods.description: Extracts and trims a 'nonce' string from a payload dictionary if present and valid.

methods.name: waitForNonce(timeoutSeconds:onTimeout:receiveNonce:)
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a nonce from the 'receiveNonce' callback until a timeout or a nonce is received.
